prompt: Write me a script that rebuilds the gaku-api Docker image and reloads it into minikube, then restarts the deployment.

assertions.text: Script has set -euo pipefail for error safety
Script sources OCI env vars (export-oci-env.sh) or sets GIT_COMMIT/BUILD_TIMESTAMP
Script restarts or redeploys gaku-api deployment
assertions.check: grep 'rollout restart' or 'rollout status' in script

assertions.text: Script has a verification/result section with [OK] or [FAIL] checks
assertions.check: grep '[OK]' or '=== Result' or 'Checklist' in script
